def fresh():
    s=S(); s.lava=False; s.water=False; s.glob=False
    s.cw=16; s.cp=2; s.ch=[16]; s.sh=True; s.swl=1; s.sm=1; s.sls=1
    return s
def apply_line(s,ln):
    for attr,key in (('LavaDeath','lava'),('WaterDeath','water'),('UsesGlobalLiquidChecks','glob')):
        m=re.search(r'\.'+attr+r' = (true|false)',ln)
        if m: setattr(s,key,m.group(1)=='true')

    if m: s.sm=int(m.group(1))
    m=re.search(r'\.StyleLineSkip = (\d+)',ln)
    if m: s.sls=int(m.group(1))
    m=re.search(r'\.CoordinateWidth = (\d+)',ln)
    if m: s.cw=int(m.group(1))
    m=re.search(r'\.CoordinatePadding = (\d+)',ln)
    if m: s.cp=int(m.group(1))
    m=re.search(r'\.CoordinateHeights = new int\[\d+\] \{ ([0-9, ]+) \}',ln)
    if m: s.ch=[int(v) for v in m.group(1).split(',')]
def dump(nt):
    return {'lava':nt.lava,'water':nt.water,'glob':nt.glob,
            'cw':nt.cw,'cp':nt.cp,'ch':list(nt.ch),'sh':nt.sh,'swl':nt.swl,'sm':nt.sm,'sls':nt.sls}
t=fresh(); sub=None; sub_styles=[]
out={}
for ln in lines:
    if re.search(r'\bnewTile = new TileObjectData',ln):
        t=fresh(); sub=None; sub_styles=[]; continue
    if re.search(r'\bnewSubTile = new TileObjectData',ln) or 'newSubTile.CopyFrom(newTile)' in ln:
        sub=fresh()
        sub.lava,sub.water,sub.glob=t.lava,t.water,t.glob
        sub.cw,sub.cp,sub.ch,sub.sh,sub.swl,sub.sm,sub.sls=t.cw,t.cp,list(t.ch),t.sh,t.swl,t.sm,t.sls
        sub_styles=[] if 'CopyFrom' not in ln else sub_styles
        continue
    if 'newSubTile.CopyFrom(' in ln and 'newTile' not in ln:
        if sub is None: sub=fresh()
        sub.lava,sub.water,sub.glob=t.lava,t.water,t.glob
        sub.cw,sub.cp,sub.ch,sub.sh,sub.swl,sub.sm,sub.sls=t.cw,t.cp,list(t.ch),t.sh,t.swl,t.sm,t.sls
        continue
    if 'newTile.CopyFrom(' in ln:
        # CopyFrom(StyleXxX):参数从基块带来——简化为不动(前块残留即近似) 
        continue
    if re.match(r'\s*newTile\.',ln): apply_line(t,ln)
    if sub is not None and re.match(r'\s*newSubTile\.',ln): apply_line(sub,ln)
    m=re.search(r'\baddSubTile\(([\d, ]+)\)',ln)
    if m:
        if sub is None: sub=fresh()
        sub_styles.append({'styles':[int(v) for v in m.group(1).split(',')], **dump(sub)})
        continue
    m=re.search(r'\baddTile\((\d+)\);',ln)
    if m:
        out[int(m.group(1))]={'base':dump(t),'subs':list(sub_styles)}
        sub=None; sub_styles=[]
json.dump(out, open('/tmp/sw-ddfin/tod_death.json','w'))
print('types:',len(out))
for k in [10,14,15,19,33,87,88,90,93,100,101,104,4]:

export function waterBoxPalmCheck(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let sum = 0;
  for (let k = x - 50; k < x + 50; k++) {
    for (let l = y - 25; l < y + 25; l++) {
      if (st.inBounds(k, l)) sum += st.liquid[st.idx(k, l)];

}

 * 一次性诊断脚本的统一 runner(防孤儿进程)。
 *
 * 背景:2026-08-10 发现 7 个 `vite-node tools/_diag-gen.mjs` 孤儿进程,

 * 约定:以后所有 _diag-*.mjs 一律经本 runner 运行,不再直接 npm exec vite-node。
 *
 * 用法:
 *   node tools/run-diag.mjs [--timeout=ms] <script.mjs> [传给脚本的参数...]
 *
 * 双层架构:
 *   - 子进程(--_child,内部):导入目标脚本;导入完成 0.5s 后强制 exit(0),
 *     不依赖事件循环自然排空——兜住"脚本主体完成但残留 interval/server 等活句柄"(本次事故形态);
 *   - 父进程(默认):只等子进程退出 + 看门狗;子进程超时(默认 120s)未退 → SIGKILL,exit 2。
 *     父进程事件循环始终空闲,因此子进程无论是同步死循环、永不 resolve 的 await
 *     还是任何未知卡死,都必然在 timeout 内被强杀。
 *
 * 退出码:0 正常 / 1 脚本异常或被信号终止 / 2 超时强杀 / 64 用法错误,其余透传脚本自设退出码。
 */
const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;
const FLUSH_MS = 500;

const argv = process.argv.slice(2);

// ---------- 子进程模式:导入目标脚本 ----------
if (argv[0] === '--_child') {
  const target = argv[1];
  try {
    const { pathToFileURL } = await import('node:url');
    const path = await import('node:path');
    await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.cwd(), target)).href);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[run-diag] 脚本异常:', e);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  // 主体完成:给 stdout 冲刷留 0.5s,无视残留活句柄强制正常退出。
  setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), FLUSH_MS).unref?.();
} else {
  // ---------- 父进程模式:spawn 子进程 + 看门狗 ----------
_ach-entry.mjs
_achprobe.mjs
_alphaprobe.mjs
_amber-visual-close.mjs

function plantSeaOat(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || !st.inBounds(x, y + 1)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (st.wall[i] > 0 || st.flags[i] || st.liquid[i] > 0) return false;   // cs:58318-58320
  if (!solidAllowBottomSlope(st, x, y + 1)) return false;
  if (!SAND_FAMILY.has(st.type[st.idx(x, y + 1)])) return false;         // cs:58321 Conversion.Sand
  if (!seaOatWaterCheck(st, gs, x, y)) return false;                     // cs:58323
  st.setTileSilent(x, y, SEAOAT, 18 * rng.nextInt(5), 0);                // cs:58333-58336
  return true;
}

/** GrowSeaOat（cs:58359-58367）：frameX < 180 时 +90（两段生长）。零掷骰 */
function growSeaOat(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (st.frameX[i] < 180) st.frameX[i] += 90;
}

/** OasisPlantWaterCheck（cs:47511-47536）：45×41 盒非实心格液量和 /255 ≥ 20。
 *  cs:47522 原版在内层判的是参数 x 而非循环变量 i（海滩带整列放空）——照抄。 */
function oasisPlantWaterCheck(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (x <= gs.beachDistance || x >= st.w - gs.beachDistance) return false;
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = x - 45; i <= x + 45; i++) {
    for (let j = y - 20; j <= y + 20; j++) {
      if (st.inBounds(i, j) && !_solidTileHB(st, i, j)) sum += st.liquid[st.idx(i, j)];
    }
  }
  return Math.trunc(sum / 255) >= 20;
}

export class RNG {
  private ur: UnifiedRandom;
  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.ur = new UnifiedRandom(seed);
  }

  next(): number {
    return this.ur.nextDouble();
  }

  /** 闭区间 [min, max]，≡ 原版 Next(min, max+1) */
  int(min: number, max: number): number {
    return this.ur.nextIntRange(min, max + 1);
  }

  range(min: number, max: number): number {
    return min + this.ur.nextDouble() * (max - min);
  }

  chance(p: number): boolean {
    return this.ur.nextDouble() < p;
  }

  pick<T>(arr: T[]): T {
    return arr[this.ur.nextInt(arr.length)];
  }

  /** 原版裸方法直通（Reset 序列/pass 级对账用，语义与 C# 完全一致） */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {

  /** C# Next()（:106-108）：裸 int32 */
  next(): number {
    return this.internalSample();
  }

  /** C# Next(minValue, maxValue)（:115-133）：[min, max)。maxValue 负值时 C# 抛异常，
   *  本移植不抛（生成期契约保证入参合法）。*/
  nextIntRange(minValue: number, maxValue: number): number {
    const num = maxValue - minValue; // C# long 减法，≤2^32，JS 精确
    if (num <= 2147483647) {
      return (Math.trunc(this.sample() * num) + minValue) | 0;
    }
    return (Math.trunc(this.getSampleForLargeRange() * num) + minValue) | 0;
  }

  /** C# Next(maxValue)（:121-127）：[0, max) */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return Math.trunc(this.sample() * maxValue);
  }

  /** C# NextDouble()（:113-115）*/
  nextDouble(): number {
    return this.sample();
  }

  /** C# Peek()（:88-99，非消耗）：下一 InternalSample 原始差值——对账/断点用 */
  peek(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    return this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
  }
}

function placeOasisPlant(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, X: number, Y: number): void {
  const style = rng.nextInt(9);                              // cs:47546——早退门之前
  if (X < gs.beachDistance || X > st.w - gs.beachDistance || Y < 5 || Y > st.h - 5) return;
  let flag = true;
  for (let i = X - 1; i <= X + 1; i++) {
    for (let j = Y - 1; j <= Y; j++) {                       // cs:47555：j < Y+1（两行）
      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;
      const k = st.idx(i, j);
      if (st.flags[k] && st.type[k] !== SEAOAT) flag = false;   // 活性且非 529 → 拒
      if (st.liquid[k] > 0) flag = false;                       // cs:47562
    }
    if (!st.inBounds(i, Y + 1) || !_solidTileHB(st, i, Y + 1)
      || !SAND_FAMILY.has(st.type[st.idx(i, Y + 1)])) flag = false;   // cs:47567-47570
  }
  if (!flag || !oasisPlantWaterCheck(st, gs, X, Y)) return;
  // cs:47582-47590：清 3×2 盒活性物（KillTile noItem——生成期 isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld
  // 强制 noItem，529 不进任何 genRand 分支 → 零掷骰；随后 6 格全被覆写，帧残留无影响）
  for (let i = X - 1; i <= X + 1; i++) {
    for (let j = Y - 1; j <= Y; j++) {
      if (st.inBounds(i, j)) st.flags[st.idx(i, j)] = 0;
    }
  }
  const fx = 54 * style;                                     // cs:47593 num3 = 54*num
  for (let i = X - 1; i <= X + 1; i++) {
    for (let j = Y - 1; j <= Y; j++) {
      st.setTileSilent(i, j, OASIS_PLANT, fx + 18 * (i - (X - 1)), 18 * (j - (Y - 1)));
    }
  }
}

function seaOatWaterCheck(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  let num = 45, num2 = 20;
  let flag = false;
  if (x <= gs.beachDistance || x >= st.w - gs.beachDistance) { flag = true; num = 65; num2 += 5; }
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = x - num; i <= x + num; i++) {
    for (let j = y - num2; j <= y + num2; j++) {
      if (st.inBounds(i, j) && !_solidTileHB(st, i, j) && st.liquid[st.idx(i, j)] > 0) {
        sum += st.liquid[st.idx(i, j)];
      }
    }
  }
  if (Math.trunc(sum / 255) >= 20) return !flag;
  return flag;
}

export function growPalmTree(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, i: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(i, y)) return false;
  let index1 = y;
  while (st.inBounds(i, index1) && st.flags[st.idx(i, index1)] && PLANTS.has(st.type[st.idx(i, index1)])) index1++;
  if (!st.inBounds(i, index1) || index1 < 1) return false;
  const gi = st.idx(i, index1);
  // 基座整砖检查(cs:27282-27286 active && !halfBrick && slope==0)
  if (!st.flags[gi] || st.half[gi] || st.slope[gi] !== 0) return false;
  // ★墙门（cs:27288-27292）：DefaultTreeWallTest(AllowsPlantsToGrow 27 项)——
  //  1405 是 wall==0；1456 放宽。液体门只查 num-1 一格
  if (!TREE_WALLS.has(st.wall[st.idx(i, index1 - 1)]) || st.liquid[st.idx(i, index1 - 1)] > 0) return false;
  if (!PALM_GROUND.has(st.type[gi])) return false;
  // 净空盒两段（cs:27296-27304）：中柱 [i,i]×[num-2,num-1] + 侧柱 [i-1,i+1]×[num-20,num-3]，
  // 均 ignoreID=20（1405 无 ignore 语义→杂草/倒木误拒）
  if (!emptyTileCheck(st, i, i, index1 - 2, index1 - 1, 20)) return false;
  if (!emptyTileCheck(st, i - 1, i + 1, index1 - 20, index1 - 3, 20)) return false;
  const height = rng.int(10, 20);                 // Next(10,21)
  const target = rng.int(-8, 8) * 2;              // Next(-8,9)*2
  let tilt = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < height; k++) {
    if (k === 0) {
      st.setTileSilent(i, index1 - 1, PALM, 66, 0);
      continue;
    }
    if (k === height - 1) {
      st.setTileSilent(i, index1 - 1 - k, PALM, 22 * rng.int(4, 6), tilt); // 顶段 fx=22*Next(4,7)
      continue;
    }
    if (tilt !== target) {
      const prog = k / height;                    // 倾斜步进阈值（L11814-11820）
      if (prog >= 0.25 && ((prog < 0.5 && rng.int(0, 12) === 0)
        || (prog < 0.7 && rng.int(0, 8) === 0)
        || (prog < 0.95 && rng.int(0, 4) === 0) || true)) {
        tilt += Math.sign(target) * 2;
      }
    }
    st.setTileSilent(i, index1 - 1 - k, PALM, 22 * rng.int(0, 2), tilt); // fx=22*Next(0,3)
  }
  return true;
}

#!/bin/zsh
# 收敛矩阵工具（#22）：批量采集原版真值 + oracle 输出 + 头部对拍。
# 用法：
#   zsh tools/convergence-matrix.sh gen <seed...>     # 采集：服务器世界 + oracle 批量（跳过已有）
#   zsh tools/convergence-matrix.sh cmp               # 对拍：输出 (ws,rl,id,moon) 差值表
# 纪律：每条子命令带超时；完成打标记；结束查进程归零。
set -u
GAME=~/Project/GLM/SandboxWorld/game
VSRV=/tmp/vserver
ORACLE_RUNFILE_GLOB="~/Library/Application Support/dotnet/runfile/caves-oracle-*/bin/debug/caves-oracle"
TIMEOUT_WRAP() { local cmd=$1 limit=$2; ( eval "$cmd" & p=$!; sleep "$limit"; kill $p 2>/dev/null ) & wait; }

cmd=${1:-cmp}
mkdir -p "$VSRV"

if [ "$cmd" = gen ]; then
  shift
  for seed in "$@"; do
    # ① 原版服务器世界（≥200s；完成标志=文件存在且 >2.5MB）
    if [ ! -s "$VSRV/s$seed.wld" ] || [ "$(stat -f%z "$VSRV/s$seed.wld" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" -lt 2500000 ]; then
      print "GEN server $seed ..."
      ( cd "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Terraria/Terraria.app/Contents/MacOS" && \
        ./TerrariaServer.bin.osx -world "$VSRV/s$seed.wld" -autocreate 1 -seed "$seed" -port 7797 -players 1 < /dev/null > "$VSRV/log_$seed.txt" 2>&1 & echo $! > "$VSRV/pid_$seed"; sleep 220; kill $(cat "$VSRV/pid_$seed") 2>/dev/null )
    fi
    # ② oracle 全链（金标旁路输出到 /tmp；用 runfile 二进制避免重建）
    if [ ! -s "$VSRV/oracle_$seed.txt" ]; then
      ORACLE=$(ls -td ~/Library/Application\ Support/dotnet/runfile/caves-oracle-* 2>/dev/null | head -1)/bin/debug/caves-oracle
      print "GEN oracle $seed ..."
      ( "$ORACLE" "$seed" 0 "$VSRV/chain_$seed.json" > "$VSRV/oracle_$seed.txt" 2>&1 & p=$!; sleep 400; kill $p 2>/dev/null ) & wait
    fi
